_title: Spinify - Custom Wheel & Decision Spinner App
_description: Spinify is an advanced wheel spinner app: create custom wheels, set probability weights, use 14 presets, nested wheels, and full spin customization.
hero_lead: Spinify is a powerful wheel and decision spinner for food picks, party games, chores, workouts, travel ideas, and everyday choices. Build your own wheels or start with ready-made presets.
screens_desc: Screens from the app: library, spin animation, editor, weights, presets, nested wheels, results, and settings.
s_1_d: Browse your custom wheels and ready-made presets with search and category filters.
s_2_d: Realistic wheel physics with haptics, confetti, and a clear winning slice.
s_3_d: Edit slices, emoji, colors, and descriptions with a live preview.
s_4_d: Slice size reflects real landing chance — rare outcomes stay rare.
s_5_d: 14 presets for food, drinks, decisions, party, chores, workout, and more.
s_6_d: Link a slice to a second wheel — great for evening plans and combos.
s_7_d: Confetti and a bold result screen when the wheel stops.
s_8_d: Tune duration, turns, easing, direction, labels, and elimination mode.
wheels_desc: Start instantly with 14 built-in wheels — customize or duplicate any of them.
w_movie_d: Action, comedy, horror, sci-fi, and more.
w_decision_d: Definitely yes, maybe, later, no, up to you.
w_chores_d: Dishes, sweeping, trash, laundry, or day off.
w_workout_d: Push-ups, squats, plank, burpees, run, or rest.
w_numbers_d: Pick a random number from 1 to 8.
w_party_d: Sing, dance, joke, impression, pardoned, or secret.
w_travel_d: Beach, mountains, city, camping, abroad, or stay home.
w_prize_d: Weighted odds — grand prize lands rarely.
w_evening_d: Opens food or movie wheels when a slice wins.
feat_desc: More than a basic spinner — full control over odds, design, and flow.
f_1_d: Adjust slice weights so landing chances match what you set.
f_2_d: Chain wheels together for multi-step decisions.
f_3_d: Remove winners each round until one slice remains.
f_4_d: Create, duplicate, and keep your wheels on device.
f_5_d: Interface and presets adapt to your language.
f_6_d: Polished design with SVG wheels and smooth animation.
how_desc: From idea to result in seconds.
how_1_d: Choose a preset or build slices with emoji and colors.
how_2_d: Fine-tune odds, spin speed, haptics, and nested links.
how_3_d: Watch the wheel spin with realistic slowdown.
how_4_d: See the winner with confetti — spin again or open a child wheel.
cta_desc: Spinify is the 4th app in the Sogepps family — fast, fair, and fun decisions on your phone.
arts_desc: Guides and game ideas around Spinify.
